content_sections.heading: RITES Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: RITES has invited applications for 10 vacancies. Each post has its own Vacancy Circular (VC) number, which must be quoted in the email subject line. The notification does not mention category-wise (reservation) vacancy details.

content_sections.heading: RITES Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification asks candidates to email their registration document and supporting documents within 10 days from the date of publication. Because no calendar date is printed, candidates should confirm the exact deadline on the official RITES website or with the contact person named below.

rows.05_10_2026: Within 10 days from the date of publication (exact calendar date not specified)

content_sections.heading: RITES Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: This requirement is only for retired (Govt/PSU) employees. Eligibility depends on the post applied for, and each post has its own educational and experience conditions, given in the next section. Two general conditions also apply: The maximum age is 64 years as on 31.10.2026. Those who have been imposed any major penalty during the last 10 years, or minor penalty during the last 05 years of service, are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.text: Where the notification shows a dash (-) under educational qualification, no minimum educational qualification is specified for that post. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RITES Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must register on the RITES website and then email the generated registration document with the required attachments. Visit the RITES website (http://www.rites.com). Go to the "Career" tab, then "Expert Registration", then "Registration for Consultant/Expert". Complete the registration format and generate the registration document. Email the registration document to Shri Narendra Mohan Soy, DGM/Civil, at [email protected] . Use the subject line: "Application for the post of ............ VC No ..../26(E)". Attach the prescribed proforma (Annexure-A and Annexure-B) and the documents listed below. Send everything within 10 days from the date of publication

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES) for filling various contract positions in Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Team Leader, Manager, and Asst. Manager across various engineering disciplines like Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, and Electronics.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies advertised under advertisement number PERS/9/6/RES/2026 for various engineering posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 15 October 2026. Applicants must submit their documents before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. Candidates need to register on the RITES website and email their documents to Shri Narendra Mohan Soy.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all advertised posts is 64 years as on the specified date, making it suitable for retired professionals.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for RITES contract posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary equivalent to 50% of the last basic pay drawn at superannuation plus Transport Allowance.

faq.question: Q8. What qualifications are required for these roles?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a graduate degree or diploma in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, or Electronics Engineering, depending on the specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting applications to these contractual positions at RITES.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The job locations for this recruitment drive are at Nawa City, District Didwana-Kuchaman, Rajasthan for the designated railway track assignment.
